issues.issue: Did the RAD breach procedural fairness by relying on updated NDP items 7.4 and 7.12 without giving the applicants a chance to respond?
issues.applicant_position: Updated NDP items were novel extrinsic evidence; the applicants had no notice and no chance to comment.
issues.respondent_position: The updated NDP was an update of publicly available information, so it was not novel extrinsic evidence.
issues.result_quote: The RAD’s failure to do so amounted to a breach of procedural fairness

issues.issue: Was the RAD's finding that Abuja is a viable internal flight alternative reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: The RAD read the country evidence selectively and ignored Boko Haram attacks in Abuja.
issues.result_quote: There is no need to consider the issue of whether the RAD erred in its assessment of the IFA
